description: Render a canonical OpenPose-colored stick figure TOP (per-limb RGB lines + per-joint colored discs on a black background, default 512×512) from an existing pose CHOP produced by create_pose_tracking. The render is GPU-rasterized in a single GLSL TOP that samples the pose CHOP via a CHOP-to-TOP. Optionally auto-wires the output to a Syphon/Spout or NDI sender for a downstream Stable Diffusion / ComfyUI / StreamDiffusion ControlNet node. No model inference — this tool produces the driver conditioning image that ControlNet consumes.

color_preset.description: Canonical OpenPose 18-keypoint COCO palette by default.

confidence_gate.description: Skip drawing landmarks/limbs whose endpoint confidence falls below this. Exposed as live knob.

coordinate_space.description: How to map landmark tx/ty to pixel space. 'normalized' maps [-1,+1] to full square. 'world' recenters using hip_midpoint and auto-scales to body height.

custom_joint_colors.description: When color_preset='custom'. Length must equal 18 (joint count).

custom_limb_colors.description: When color_preset='custom'. Length must equal 17 (limb count).

expose_controls.description: Expose live JointRadius, LimbThickness, ConfidenceGate, Mirror knobs.

joint_radius.description: Filled-disc radius (px) for each keypoint joint. Exposed as live JointRadius knob.

limb_thickness.description: Line thickness (px) for each limb. Exposed as live LimbThickness knob.

mirror.description: Flip horizontally (selfie cam vs. ControlNet expectation).

output_mode.description: When 'internal' stops at a Null TOP. When 'syphon_spout'/'ndi' adds an FM-01 external sender.

parent_path.description: Parent network for the pose_controlnet_driver baseCOMP.

pose_chop_path.description: Required when source='existing_tracker'. Absolute TD path to the canonical 33-sample pose CHOP (tx/ty/tz/confidence).

resolution.description: Square render size. ControlNet SD1.5 wants 512; SDXL wants 768/1024.

sender_name.description: Sender/source name advertised on the network when output_mode != 'internal'.

source.description: Where the pose stream comes from. 'existing_tracker' reads a 33-sample pose CHOP at pose_chop_path. 'synthetic' auto-spins-up a synthetic Script CHOP inside this container for device-free preview.

name: create_pose_controlnet_driver
title: Create pose ControlNet driver
